verdicts.reason: I'd ship B before A, but both still need fixes. A has no consistent left edge: the logo, subtext and flavour pills sit at about x=76 while the headline starts further left at about x=64, so it looks ragged. A's headline also runs to within about 30px of the right edge, its pills sit closer together than the gap below the CTA, and the bottom is dead space. B lines the logo, headline, subtext and pills up on one left margin at about 45px, and its pill gaps are even. Both share the same problems: the CTA floats on its own on the right between the copy and the pills, so the flavour pills come after the button in reading order. The peach circle in the top right is shrunk to a small scrap in the corner, and the yellow circle sits behind the start of the headline.
